## About this site

Slides, lab notebooks, and reference material for HWRS 564a. Slides are
interactive: the code blocks run in your browser, so you can edit an example and
see what changes without leaving the page.

Graded work is submitted through D2L. This site holds the material; D2L holds the
gradebook.

::: {.due-notice}
**Getting started:** open the [course repository](https://github.com/HWRS564-hydrogeologic-analysis/hwrs564a_course_materials),
click *Code → Codespaces → Create codespace*, and keep the setup log open until
it prints **Ready**. The course environment and Jupyter kernel are built
automatically. Do this before the first class of Week 2.
:::

## How class works

Each week has two sessions. Most sessions mix short lecture segments with coding
exercises you work through in the slides. Most weeks open with a five-minute
quiz on the previous week's material — ten over the semester, two lowest dropped.

Seven homework assignments are due every other Wednesday at 11:59pm through
D2L. HW 1 is released during Week 2; after that, the next assignment opens on
the Thursday following each deadline. Each D2L assignment contains the full
prompt, and students create and submit their own executed Jupyter notebook.
